about:
Nebraska Scooter Mart LLC opened in January 2004 in Lincoln, Nebraska, as a locally owned medical equipment store. Since its founding, the business has served the Lincoln area as a dedicated provider of mobility assistive equipment, building a reputation for consistent local presence.

The company operates as a medical equipment retailer, offering a selection that includes hospital beds and related products, as well as bath safety products and other mobility assistive devices. In addition to sales, the firm maintains a staff of service technicians who perform equipment repair and maintenance, supporting the products they sell through both in-shop and on-site service.

The customer base encompasses individuals requiring mobility assistance as well as healthcare providers and facilities that need reliable medical equipment. The company’s product focus on hospital beds and bath safety items aligns with the needs of home care and institutional settings, and its technicians work directly with clients to ensure proper equipment fit and function.

Nebraska Scooter Mart distinguishes itself as the longest-tenured locally owned medical equipment store in Lincoln. The company also points to its team of dedicated professionals, who collectively hold an average of 20 years of experience in the field of mobility assistive equipment, as a key reason customers rely on their expertise for both product selection and ongoing support.
